skills.coverage_note: Current executable scope is the autographes constellation. Other constellations are retained as investigation candidates, not asserted resolved.
Validated scope: public papyri search, not every Princeton digital collection.
MODS location URLs; object-shaped url values. Array-shaped url values use the second recipe.
Enumerates only Stanford originals declared in the public FromThePage contribution index. Not the whole Stanford catalogue. Original PURL Manifests, not synthetic manifests, are fetched.
Biblissima is an aggregator. Current executable recipe covers the explicitly linked IRHT Manifest namespace; other repositories are not yet asserted resolved.
Official API requires a supported filter. Validated scope is maker 5560 (Edgar Degas), not the entire museum. Other documented maker/department filters remain configuration.
URL-encode the complete ARK, including colon and slashes. Scope is the public map query; non-Work catalogue records are skipped.
Official curated featured manifests, not Smithsonian-wide catalogue enumeration or all individual objects.
